summary: Iter17 SAWALI — CRM Notes & Tasks per client + task.reminder automation tested end-to-end. BACKEND: 24/24 new pytest tests GREEN in /app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter17.py (~5s). Combined regression iter12+13+14+15+16+17 = 108/108 GREEN in ~23s (pytest_iter17_full.xml). Coverage split into 5 classes: (A) TestNotes — 401/403/200 auth, GET list empty, POST 400 'Le texte de la note est requis' for empty/whitespace, POST 400 for >5000 chars, POST 200 returns full doc shape (id, client_id, text, author_id, author_label, created_at) and list reflects insert, DELETE 404 unknown, DELETE 200 {ok:true}. (B) TestTasks — 401/403 auth, POST 400 'Titre de la tâche requis', POST 400 'Date d'échéance invalide' on bad ISO, POST 200 returns full doc shape (id, client_id, title, due_at, status='open', remind_via_whatsapp, reminder_sent_at=null, created_at), PUT 400 on invalid status, PUT 404 unknown, PUT 200 status='done' then GET confirms persistence, DELETE 404 unknown, DELETE 200. (C) TestTimelineNotesTasks — default timeline counts now has 'note' and 'task' keys each >=1, events include note+task types; ?types=note returns ONLY notes (counts.note==len, counts.task==0); ?types=task returns ONLY tasks (counts.task==len, counts.note==0). (D) TestAutomationEvent — /api/admin/automations/events returns exactly 5 events with 'task.reminder' (label='Rappel de tâche', description mentions '1h'/'horaire'); POST /api/admin/automations with event='task.reminder' returns 200/201. (E) TestTaskReminderCron — seeds task with due_at=now+30min/status=open/remind=true/reminder_sent_at=None + enabled automation on 'task.reminder' + phone on user + monkeypatches server._wa_send_template to capture; 1st _task_reminder_cron() run stamps reminder_sent_at (no longer None) AND captures==1 WA send; 2nd run captures stays at 1 (idempotent — task's reminder_sent_at filters it out). FRONTEND (Playwright with admin JWT injected): /admin/clients/<id>/timeline renders client-timeline-page. 7 filter pills all present (timeline-filter-{appointment,intervention,whatsapp,form,document,note,task}). notes-panel + tasks-panel render side-by-side above the timeline. All 9 panel testids present (notes-panel, tasks-panel, note-text-input, note-add-btn, task-title-input, task-due-date, task-due-time, task-add-btn, task-remind-toggle). Empty-text POST → toast 'Note vide' ✓. Creating note via note-text-input+note-add-btn → note appears in panel AND in timeline-event-note-<id> (note=1 in count) ✓. Creating task via task-title-input + task-due-date + task-due-time + task-add-btn → task appears in panel AND in timeline-event-task-<id> (task=1 in count) ✓. task-toggle-<id> PUT toggles status; title gets line-through class in DOM ✓. Timeline shows both new events grouped under 'MAI 2026 (2)' header with distinct colored markers (amber note, fuchsia task) ✓. Screenshot saved at .screenshots/iter17_timeline_notes_tasks.png.

ui_bugs.issue: task-delete-<id> button uses 'opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100' so the trash icon is only visible on row-hover. Functional in pure mouse usage but reduces discoverability on touch devices and made the Playwright click (force=True) not always register a DOM-level event. LOW priority ergonomics.

action_items: (LOW) Consider making task-delete-<id> button always visible (or always on mobile) to improve discoverability; current opacity-0/group-hover pattern hides the action.
(LOW, carry-over iter16) server.py is ~7117 lines — splitting into routers (auth/admin/portal/forms/whatsapp/scheduler/automations/templates/timeline/crm_notes_tasks/db) is increasingly overdue.

(INFO) Test script fix applied: /app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter14.py::test_admin_returns_four_events updated from strict equality to issubset so it tolerates new automation events (iter17 added 'task.reminder').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _task_reminder_cron (~1438-1469) filters on {status:'open', remind_via_whatsapp:true, reminder_sent_at:None, due_at∈[now, now+1h]} — correctly uses ISO string comparison (matches how due_at is stored by admin_create_task). Idempotency is guaranteed by stamping reminder_sent_at=_now() AFTER _emit_event completes, verified by the double-invocation test.

server.py _task_reminder_cron swallows exceptions on both _emit_event and the update_one call via try/except: pass. Mild risk — if _emit_event throws but the stamp succeeds, we lose the reminder silently; if _emit_event succeeds but the stamp throws, next cron run will resend. Consider logging.exception and ordering emit→stamp in a single try block. LOW.
server.py admin_create_task (~1369-1402) parses due_at with datetime.fromisoformat().replace('Z','+00:00') — handles both 'Z' and '+00:00' suffix correctly. Default tz added if naive. ✓

server.py admin_update_task merges only non-None fields (model_dump() + v is not None filter) — so clients can PATCH just status without clobbering title. Valid status enforcement happens BEFORE the empty-update early return. ✓

server.py timeline (~1228-1266) appends notes with ts=created_at and tasks with ts=due_at_or_created_at — tasks are sorted in the timeline by due date which is semantically nicer than 'when the task was created'. Good choice.

server.py SUPPORTED_AUTOMATION_EVENTS is a set; _emit_event gate at line 5265 early-returns on unsupported events — safe. Adding 'task.reminder' required 3 edits (set, events endpoint list, cron callsite) and all 3 are present.

AdminClientTimeline.jsx load() uses Promise.all for parallel fetch of timeline + notes + tasks — 3 concurrent HTTP calls, nice. On error, any single failure short-circuits all three via the shared try/catch (user gets one toast). Acceptable but could be split into per-call try blocks if one resource frequently fails.

AdminClientTimeline.jsx task-delete-<id> uses 'opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100' — hides the trash icon until row-hover. See frontend_issues.ui_bugs: LOW-priority discoverability concern, especially on touch devices.

AdminClientTimeline.jsx overdue styling: tasks with new Date(due_at) < Date.now() && status==='open' gets a rose-tinted card — simple + effective. Confirmed visually in screenshot: the newly-created future-due task is NOT rose (as expected).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter17 suite = /app/backend/tests/test_sawali_iter17.py (24 tests, ~5s). Cron pattern for future 'event + monkeypatch _wa_send_template' tests: (a) sys.path.insert(0,'/app/backend') then `import server`; (b) replace server._wa_send_template with an async capturing function; (c) use the session-scoped event_loop fixture from conftest.py and call event_loop.run_until_complete(server._task_reminder_cron()); (d) ALWAYS restore original in finally. For task-reminder end-to-end you must seed BOTH an enabled automation doc on 'task.reminder' AND give the client's user a phone (phone must be set for _emit_event to actually call _wa_send_template — otherwise it skips and only writes a whatsapp_messages error row). Backend CRUD contract: notes text 1..5000 chars; task titles required; due_at must parse via datetime.fromisoformat (accepts 'Z' or '+00:00' suffix or naive→UTC); task.status only 'open'|'done'. Timeline counts dict has 7 keys; ?types=note/task filter pre-query. Frontend data-testids: timeline-filter-{7 types}, notes-panel, note-text-input, note-add-btn, note-delete-<id>, tasks-panel, task-title-input, task-due-date, task-due-time, task-remind-toggle, task-add-btn, task-<id>, task-toggle-<id>, task-delete-<id>. Also: I patched iter14's test_admin_returns_four_events to issubset check — do not regress that.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The Notes & Tasks CRM enhancement (backend CRUD, timeline integration, task.reminder automation event wiring, hourly cron with stamp-after-emit idempotency, 7-pill filter UI, side-by-side notes/tasks panels above a monthly-grouped timeline showing note+task events with colored markers) all match the spec. The only regression (iter14's 4-events strict equality) was an expected consequence of legitimately expanding SUPPORTED_AUTOMATION_EVENTS — fixed in the test assertion (issubset) since the backend deliberately returns one more event now. task-delete button opacity-0 is a pre-existing UX pattern; flagged LOW for a future mobile-friendliness pass.
